title: Three Shifts and One Short Switch
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：output　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 output 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the operator ① raised the output that no trainee in the station would have noted, and he said the raising was the whole of the shift. The ② output, meaning the yield itself and not the switch, ran three shifts and stayed unnoted in the book; output, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ sort of output in that station had the same short switch beside it, and the ④ output at the far screen, meaning the cable they kept for the children to check and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Output, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the operator said the noting is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the output was the whole of the matter, meaning the effort and not the yield. The ⑥ output, meaning the effort and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; output, he said, is either something you raise or the only word that means both yield and an effort. He said the effort is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ output had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short switch. The ⑧ output of the whole thing, the operator wrote in June, was one station and three shifts of noting; output, he said, is either the cable at the far screen or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ output I remember is the output noted in the log, which closed in 1980 and is still noted as the quietest in the station. ⑩ Output, my mother said in 1982, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all output, she said, is an effort that has agreed to look like yield. She said the effort was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 产量；输出（指机房里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 产量；输出（指那份产量本身，与小小的开关相对）
C. 固定搭配：raise the output 提高这一份产量
D. n. 产量；输出（指留给孩子们查的那一根）
E. n. 产量之事（抽象总称，指一处机房的产量之事）
F. n. 产量；输出（指运行日志里写到、被记下的那一份）
G. n. 产量、工夫（指一件事里人人都按却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 工夫（抽象总称，指人人都按却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: raised the output that no trainee in the station would have noted
The output, meaning the yield itself and not the switch
Every sort of output in that station
the output at the far screen
the output was the whole of the matter
the output had become a line in a log
The output of the whole thing

answers.why: raise the output 意为“提高这一份产量”，1973 年那位操作员把机房里没有一位实习生肯记下的一份产量做了一遍。
output 意为“产量；输出”，指那份产量本身而不是小小的开关，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被记下。
output 意为“产量；输出”，指机房里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一个小小的开关。
output 意为“产量；输出”，指最远那块屏幕的留给孩子们查的那一根，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
output 意为“产量、工夫”，指一件事里人人都按却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份工夫就是那件事的全部。
output 意为“工夫”，指人人都按却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份产量，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
output 意为“产量；输出”，指运行日志里写到、被记下的那一份，到 1978 年这一份成了运行日志里的一行。
output 意为“产量之事”，操作员六月写道，整件事的产量之事是一处机房和三个班次的记下。
output 意为“产量；输出”，我记得的是运行日志里记下过的那一份，1980 年调好了，至今仍被说成机房里最安静的一份。
output 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，产量是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的产量。
